meta.title: The Bible that does not track you. 4 languages. No ads.
meta.description: RoBible is a free web app for reading, searching and studying the Bible. No trackers, no ads, no marketing cookies. In Romanian, Spanish, English and Chinese.

hero.title: Scripture you can trust. And in your pocket.
hero.lede: 66 books. 31,102 verses. 4 languages. Smart search, version comparison, synced notes — all without ads, trackers, or subscriptions.

demo.hint: Type a reference (e.g. rom 3 5) and press Enter — we take you to the verse, highlighted in green.
demo.no_results: No results. Try another format (e.g. rom 3 5, 1co 13 4, acts 2 38).

features.title: Features built for serious study — and comfortable reading.

f1.title: Reference search, not index lookup
f1.text: Type 'rom 3 5' or '1 john 2 6' or 'genesis 1:1' and you arrive directly. Diacritics and typos are handled.

f2.title: Search the text, not just quotes
f2.text: Search words, phrases, or combinations. You can search the whole Bible, a single testament, or one book.

f3.title: Compare versions, verse by verse
f3.text: See the same passage in two translations, side by side. Useful for deep study or teaching.

f4.title: Notes and favorites in the cloud
f4.text: Write notes on verses, group them by topic, save favorites. Everything syncs across devices, free, no card.
f4.example: Your note on John 3:16 — on phone, tablet, laptop.

why.title: Because a Bible should not be a product.
why.lede: We don't want your money, your attention, or your data. We just want you to read Scripture without obstacles.

w1.title: No trackers. No ads. No marketing cookies.
w1.text: No Google Analytics, no Facebook Pixel, no sponsored content. You read, that's it.

w2.title: Works offline (PWA).
w2.text: Install the app on your phone. It downloads once, then works without internet. Perfect for travel, sermons, retreats.

w3.title: 4 languages from day one: ro, es, en, zh.
w3.text: We don't add languages for marketing. We add them because everyone deserves Scripture in their own tongue.

w4.title: Open source. No surprises.
w4.text: The code is on GitHub. If you don't like a decision, you can change it. Or find someone who will.

p1.title: Individual study
p1.text: You read, search, take notes. No distraction, no mandatory account, no ads between verses.

p2.title: Teaching and group study
p2.text: Compare translations, take notes by topic, prepare lessons without fighting the interface.

p3.title: Just curiosity
p3.text: You want to find a quote you heard on the radio. You don't need an account. You type and find.

compare.title: What we have. What we don't. No promises.
compare.lede: We don't claim to be perfect. Here is what we offer — and what we don't — against typical Bible apps.

faq.title: What you did not find elsewhere
faq.a1: Yes, completely. No ads, no subscription, no card. The project is sustained by volunteer work and optional donations.
faq.a2: Notes and favorites are stored encrypted at Cloudflare. We do not sell or share anything. You can delete your account anytime.
faq.a3: Yes. It is a progressive web app (PWA) — you install it from the browser and it behaves like a native app. Works on iOS, Android, any tablet or laptop.
faq.q4: Where do the translations come from?
faq.a4: Romanian version: Biblia Cornilescu (VDC). Spanish version: Reina Valera (RVL). These are public-domain translations or used with permission.
faq.a5: Yes — corrections, new translations, features. The code is on GitHub. And prayers count.

final.title: Let's read.
final.text: No account. No app to download. Just Scripture, in your language, on any screen.
